title: Big Dent Dyna Stem
description:
Big Dent Dyna Stem
The large glass stem produces a really smooth vapour in dynavap standards. The long vapour path coupled with the large dents creates a very turbulent vapour path that really does cool things down.
The Big Dent also has an airport near the tip end. And has a length of approximately 15cm without a tip installed.
﻿DYNAVAP tip and cap NOT included.
Included
1 x Big Dent Dyna Stem
